notes: All 23 townsfolk rebuilt on a new skeleton with 84 motion-captured-style animations (free CC0 Universal Animation Library)
Elders now sit on benches and chat, gardeners water plants, woodcutters chop, smiths kneel and repair, fishers lean on the rail
Smoother walk, jog and a real sprint for the player; new hit, knock-out and wave reactions
Character and animation files are now half the size (10.6 MB → 5.1 MB) (faster loading, especially on phones)
